Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area several times a day.
entries.1회 15 mL, 1일 2회 약 1분 동안 양치질하고, 의치로 인한 구내: Rinse the mouth with 15 mL per dose for about 1 minute, 2 times a day; in the case of stomatitis caused by dentures, soak and clean the dentures for 15 minutes 2 times a day. Increase or decrease the amount appropriately according to age and symptoms.
For those aged 2 years and over, apply an appropriate amount to the affected area 1 to 3 times a day.
entries.과산화수소, 타우로리딘, 탄닌산, 아세틸살리실산, 비스무스와 함께 사용하: Do not use it together with hydrogen peroxide, taurolidine, tannic acid, acetylsalicylic acid or bismuth. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when it is used together with lithium preparations, chlorhexidine, sulfadiazine, silver compounds, alkalis, preparations containing mercury, octenidine hydrochloride, enzyme-based wound treatments, proteins or other unsaturated organic compounds.
entries.국소 및 전신 알레르기 증상(때때로 발진, 두드러기), 접촉성 습진, 드: If local and systemic allergic symptoms (occasionally rash or hives), contact eczema, rarely shock symptoms (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), or photosensitisation occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.급격히 에틸렌옥사이드를 흡입하면 메스꺼움(구토직후에 일어나는 경우와 시간: Sudden inhalation of ethylene oxide may cause nausea (which may occur immediately after vomiting or only after some time has passed), dizziness, a feeling of collapse, chest pain, irritation of the respiratory tract and neuralgia. Repeated exposure to large amounts may dull the sense of smell and weaken tolerance to ethylene oxide vapour.
entries.드물게 국소 자극이나 민감성, 화상 또는 상처난 피부부위에 적용될 때 대: Rarely, local irritation or sensitivity may occur, and when it is applied to burned or broken skin areas, systemic effects such as metabolic acidosis and reduced renal function may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽 증상(구역, 불쾌감, 식은 땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock symptoms occur rarely (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, seizures), or if rash or hives occurs occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Temporary parotitis, increased staining of the teeth and of the surfaces of the oral cavity (inside of the mouth), increased formation of supragingival calculus, changes in taste sensation, desquamation of the oral (inside of the mouth) mucosa in children, and mild irritation may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽 증상(호흡곤란, 홍조, 두드러기 등), 요오드진, 때때로 통증: If shock symptoms occur rarely (difficulty breathing, flushing, hives and the like), or iodine rash, or occasionally pain, itching, irritation, rash, congested and reddened skin or dermatitis, or rarely a burning sensation, skin ulcers or skin discolouration, or rarely small blisters, or very rarely angioedema, or symptoms of thyroid abnormality including tension, depressed mood, difficulty sleeping, trembling of the hands, a fast or irregular heartbeat, abnormal breathing, a feeling of heat or sweating, weight loss, weight gain and fatigue, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.드물게 쇽(구역, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적 등), 때: If shock occurs rarely (nausea, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness and the like), or if rash or hives occurs occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.드물게 쇽, 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적: If shock, nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing or redness occurs rarely, or if rash or hives occurs occasionally, or if anaphylactic shock of unknown frequency occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitisation may occur.
entries.매우 흔하게 적용부위 자극감, 드물게 적용부위 피부염을 포함한 적용부위: If very commonly a feeling of irritation at the application site occurs, or rarely hypersensitivity reactions at the application site including dermatitis at the application site, or rarely application site reactions including pain, itching, erythema, rash and a burning sensation of the skin, or a temporary reduction in sweating, or redness (congested and reddened skin), stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.미온수 1리터당 이 약 분말 15 g 또는 20 g의 비율로 조절하여 2: Adjust the ratio to 15 g or 20 g of the powder of this medicine per 1 litre of lukewarm water and mix well for 2 to 3 minutes until the powder is completely dissolved. Wash the instruments to be sterilised first, then leave them soaking in this activated solution for 5 to 10 minutes. Rinse the instruments with sterile water before use. When sterilisation is required, treat them in a 2% activated solution for 10 minutes; for disinfection, treat them in a 1.5% activated solution for 5 minutes.
entries.비누류는 이 약의 살균작용을 약화시키므로 충분히 씻어 제거한 후 사용하십: Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use.
entries.손 및 피부의 소독 시 0.05~0.2 % 수용액으로 약 5분간 씻어낸: For disinfection of the hands and skin, wash for about 5 minutes with a 0.05 to 0.2 % aqueous solution and then wipe clean with sterile gauze or cloth. For disinfection of the skin at the surgical site, wash the skin surface to be operated on with a 0.1 % aqueous solution for about 5 minutes and then apply a 0.2 % aqueous solution. For disinfection of the mucous membranes at the surgical site and for disinfection of wounded areas of the skin and mucous membranes, use a 0.01 to 0.05 % aqueous solution. For disinfection of medical devices, immerse them in a 0.05 to 0.2 % aqueous solution for 10 to 15 minutes; however, for disinfection related to tuberculosis patients use a 0.2 to 0.5 % aqueous solution. For disinfection of operating room and ward furniture, instruments and articles, use a 0.05 to 0.2 % aqueous solution; however, for disinfection related to tuberculosis patients use a 0.2 to 0.5 % aqueous solution.
entries.식사 후 양치 후 1일 3~4회, 3~4주 동안 모든 증상이 소실될 때까: Use it continuously after meals and after brushing the teeth, 3 to 4 times a day for 3 to 4 weeks, until all symptoms have disappeared. When using it, rinse the mouth with about 10 ml for 1 to 2 minutes. However, do not dilute it before use.
entries.외용으로만 사용하십시오.원액 또는 농후액이 눈에 들어가지 않도록 주의하고: Use it externally only. Take care to keep the undiluted or concentrated solution out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse the eyes thoroughly with water. When a concentrated solution is used, irritation of the skin and mucous membranes may occur, so use it with care. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. If iron instruments have to be immersed for a long time, dissolve sodium nitrite in the solution to prevent corrosion, except for copper items. (This does not affect the bactericidal action.)
entries.용도에 따라 원액 및 다음의 농도로 희석하여 사용하십시오.손 및 피부 소: Use it undiluted or diluted to the following concentrations according to the intended use. For disinfection of the hands and skin (excluding hand disinfection of health and hygiene workers and of the operator during surgery, and disinfection of the skin at the surgical site) use a 0.1 to 0.5% aqueous solution; for disinfection of medical devices use a 0.1 to 0.5% aqueous solution; for disinfection of furniture and instruments and for disinfection of wounded areas of the skin use a 0.05% aqueous solution.
entries.이 약 또는 기타 아미드계 국소마취제에 과민증 환자, 5개월 미만의 유아: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or to other amide-type local anaesthetics, or in infants under 5 months of age. Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and patients with liver or heart abnormalities should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Do not use it for dental treatment in children.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자, 뇌, 척수, 귀(내이, 중이, 외이), 질, 방: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, ear (inner, middle or outer ear), vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, or on the eyes. Patients with hypersensitivity to other medicines and patients with an allergic disease such as asthma or a history or family history of one should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. When it is used over a wide area or for a long period, take care not to inhale the vapour. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Do not use it for obstetric and gynaecological purposes (such as disinfection of the vagina and vulva) or for urological purposes (such as disinfection of the external genitalia and mucosal surfaces). When disinfecting instruments that may come into contact with nerves or mucosal surfaces, such as syringes and catheters, rinse them thoroughly with sterile water before use. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자, 뇌, 척수, 귀, 질, 방광, 구강 등의 점막면: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, ear, vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, or on the eyes. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have hypersensitivity to other medicines, if you are a patient with an allergic disease such as asthma or a history or family history of one, or if it is to be applied around the vulva immediately before delivery. Use it externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. When it is used over a wide area or for a long period, take care not to inhale the vapour. Contact with the eyes may cause serious corneal damage that can require a corneal transplant (corneal erosion, epithelial defect / corneal damage, severe permanent visual impairment), so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Do not use it for obstetric and gynaecological purposes (such as disinfection of the vagina and vulva) or for urological purposes (such as disinfection of the external genitalia and mucosal surfaces). When disinfecting instruments that may come into contact with nerves or mucosal surfaces, such as syringes and catheters, rinse them thoroughly with sterile water before use. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it. Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and patients with an allergic disease such as asthma or anyone who has experienced one should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it externally only; do not take it and do not inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes and ears, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use.
Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it or in infants aged 2 months or younger. Do not use it for disinfecting surgical instruments or on the brain, spinal cord, eyes, ears (inner, middle or outer ear) or mucous membranes (especially genital mucosa). Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a patient with hypersensitivity to other medicines, a patient with an allergic constitution, or if it is to be applied to broken skin (especially burns) or to large areas of immature skin. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it and do not inject it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. It is a flammable liquid, so handle it with care. Dry the treated area before using electrical equipment.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 2개월 이하의 영유아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it or in infants and young children aged 2 months or younger. Do not use it for disinfecting surgical instruments or on the brain, spinal cord, eyes, ears (inner, middle or outer ear) or mucous membranes (especially genital mucosa). Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to other medicines and patients with an allergic constitution should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it externally only; do not take it and do not inject it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. It is a flammable liquid, so handle it with care. Dry the treated area before using electrical equipment.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 뇌, 척수, 귀(내이, 중이, 외이), 질, 방광: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, ear (inner, middle or outer ear), vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, on the eyes, or on eroded (macerated) or suppurating affected areas. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics, if you have an allergic constitution, if it is to be applied around the vulva immediately before delivery, or if the affected area is extensive with severe wounds or severe burns. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only and do not take it internally. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. If soap is used, wash it off thoroughly beforehand and then use this medicine. Anions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Before use, wash the wounded area and the contaminants around it thoroughly. If there is no improvement in the symptoms after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to other medicines and anyone who has experienced an allergic disease such as asthma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Do not use it on the eyes, ears or mouth, or on extensive wounds or burns. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Anions contained in saline and similar solutions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.벗겨지거나 손상된 피부: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not use it on broken or damaged skin or on recently shaved areas. It must be used only on the area to be treated, and it must be applied after the application area has been kept completely dry. Take care that it does not touch the eyes or mucous membranes. Bathing must be avoided immediately before applying this medicine, and at least one hour must have passed after application. Do not remove underarm hair within 12 hours before or after applying this medicine.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전에: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Before using this medicine, patients with an allergic disease such as asthma or anyone who has experienced one, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children under 18 years of age, and anyone who has experienced hypersensitivity or an allergy to propylene glycol should consult a doctor or pharmacist. It may cause an imbalance of the normal bacterial flora in the oral cavity, so do not normally use it for more than 10 days. Use it as a mouthwash only and do not use it internally. It may cause staining of oral surfaces such as the tooth surfaces, prostheses and the underside of the tongue.
This medicine is used for hyperhidrosis of the armpits, hands and feet.
entries.이 약은 다음과 같은 순서대로 사용합니다.미리, 전 세척한 의료기구를 소: Use this medicine in the following order. First, immerse the pre-cleaned medical instruments completely in the disinfectant solution. For instruments and machinery with fine pores or a complex structure, use pressure injection or suction so that they are thoroughly wetted with the prepared disinfectant solution. Perform a leak test first if necessary. Immerse completely for at least 5 minutes, or for at least 6 minutes in the case of tubercle bacilli. After thorough immersion, remove the items and rinse them with at least 200 mL of running sterile purified water, or with water according to the purpose of use. For instruments with fine pores or a complex structure the disinfectant solution tends to remain inside, so rinse thoroughly by pressure-injecting sterile purified water or water, or by extending the rinsing time.
entries.이 약은 손 및 피부의 소독(보건위생종사자 및 수술 시 수술자의 손 소독: This medicine is used for disinfection of the hands and skin (excluding hand disinfection of health and hygiene workers and of the operator during surgery, and disinfection of the skin at the surgical site), disinfection of medical devices, disinfection of furniture and instruments, and disinfection of wounded areas of the skin.
This medicine is used for hand disinfection during surgery and for hygienic purposes.
entries.이 약은 수술전 살균소독(수술자 및 보건위생 종사자의 손소독)에 사용합니: This medicine is used for bactericidal disinfection before surgery (hand disinfection of the operator and of health and hygiene workers).
entries.이 약은 의료기구의 소독 및 멸균(열에 민감한 내시경 포함)에 사용합니다: This medicine is used for the disinfection and sterilisation of medical instruments (including heat-sensitive endoscopes).
This medicine is used for dryness of the pharynx (throat) and of the oral cavity (inside of the mouth).
entries.이 약은 퇴행성관절염(골관절염), 어깨관절주위염, 건(힘줄)•건초염(힘줄: This medicine is used for the relief of pain and inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder joint, tendinitis (inflammation of the tendons) and tenosynovitis (inflammation of the tendon sheath), peritendinitis, humeral epicondylitis (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
entries.이 약은 희석하지 않고 원액 그대로 사용합니다.수술시 수술자의 손 소독에: Use this medicine undiluted, as the neat solution. When it is used for hand disinfection by the operator during surgery, take 5 mL of this medicine in the palm, spread it evenly over both hands and arms (up to the elbows), then rub for at least 3 minutes while allowing it to dry, and carry this out 2 times. When it is used for hand disinfection for hygienic purposes, take 3 mL of this medicine in the palm, spread it evenly over both hands, then rub for 30 seconds while allowing it to dry.
entries.이 약을 인체에 사용하지 마십시오.활성액 사용 및 보관할 때에는 뚜껑이: Do not use this medicine on the human body. When using and storing the activated solution, use a container with a lid or similar to prevent the vapour from spreading, and at the same time take care to ventilate the area. Handle it with sufficient care, for example by wearing protective equipment such as goggles, gloves and a mask, to protect the eyes and skin and to avoid inhaling the powder of this medicine. Clean thoroughly before disinfection to remove visible contaminants. Take sufficient care in storage and handling so that it is not drunk or swallowed by mistake.
entries.인체에 사용하지 마십시오.피부에 닿았을 경우 즉시 오염된 의복 등을 벗고: Do not use it on the human body. If it comes into contact with the skin, immediately remove the contaminated clothing and wash the area thoroughly with running water. If pain continues, consult a doctor or pharmacist. If it gets into the eyes, immediately rinse them with running water for 15 minutes and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Delayed or insufficient rinsing may cause damage to the eyes. If the vapour is inhaled, move immediately to a place with fresh air, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.일반 피부 및 상처부위 세정에는 세정할 부위를 물로 닦고, 피부나 상처에: For cleansing of general skin and wounded areas, wet the area to be cleansed with water, take only the minimum amount needed for application to the skin or wound, apply it and then wipe it off gently. Rinse thoroughly with water. For hand disinfection during surgery, wet the hands and forearms with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and up to the elbows and rub for about 3 minutes using a brush or a sponge. Rinse thoroughly under running water, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry completely. For personal hand disinfection, wet the hands with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and rub both hands vigorously for 15 seconds. Rinse with water and dry completely. For disinfection of the skin before surgery, apply a sufficient amount to the surgical site and rub for at least 2 minutes. Dry with a sterile towel, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry with a sterile towel.
entries.일시적으로 자극감이나 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐) 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을: If a temporary feeling of irritation or redness (congested and reddened skin) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Apply an appropriate amount to the application area in the evening and wash it off with water the next morning. Use it once every night until sweating (perspiration) stops, and reduce it to 1 to 2 times a week once the symptoms improve (get better).
entries.저녁에 적용 부위에 적당량을 바른 후, 다음 날 아침에 물로 씻어 제거하: Apply an appropriate amount to the application area in the evening and wash it off with water the next morning. Use it once every night until perspiration, that is sweating, stops, and once the symptoms improve reduce it to 1 to 2 uses a week.
entries.제모제는 이 약 사용하기 전 또는 후로부터 12시간 이내에는 환부에 사용: Do not use depilatories on the affected area within 12 hours before or after using this medicine.
entries.클로르헥시딘, 이소프로판올 과민증 경험자, 수술기구 소독, 뇌, 척수,: Do not use this medicine in anyone who has experienced hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine or isopropanol, for disinfecting surgical instruments, on the brain, spinal cord, eyes, ears (inner, middle or outer ear) or mucous membranes, especially genital mucosa, or in infants and young children aged 2 months or younger. Before using this medicine, patients with an allergic disease such as asthma, anyone who has experienced one, or patients with a family history of one should consult a doctor or pharmacist. It is for external use only; it is not taken orally and is not injected. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, fresh solution is supplied whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. It is a flammable liquid, so handle it with care. Dry the treated area before using electrical equipment.
entries.트림, 구역, 구토, 때때로 구강마비감, 자상감, 작열감, 드물게 과민반: Belching, nausea and vomiting may occur, occasionally a feeling of numbness in the mouth, a pricking sensation or a burning sensation, and rarely hypersensitivity reactions.
entries.피부에 닿았을 경우 즉시 오염된 의복 등을 벗고, 흐르는 물로 충분히 씻: If it comes into contact with the skin, immediately remove the contaminated clothing and wash the area thoroughly with running water. If it gets into the eyes, immediately rinse them with running water for at least 15 minutes and then consult a doctor. If the vapour is inhaled, move immediately to a place with fresh air and then consult a doctor. If it is swallowed by mistake, immediately have the person drink a large amount of water or milk, do not force vomiting, and consult a doctor. During use and storage, use a container with a lid or similar to prevent the vapour from spreading, and at the same time take care to ventilate the area. During washing and disinfection, wear protective equipment such as rubber gloves, a gown, a mask and protective goggles to prevent contact with or inhalation of infectious material and of the disinfectant solution. Depending on the instrument or machine, rusting or degradation may occur, so do not use it continuously for more than 1 hour.
Use it directly without diluting it.
